mapper.sql: hit_list_id AS hitListId, hit_id AS hitId, list_type AS listType, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_screening_hit_list(hit_list_id, hit_id, list_type, create_time) VALUES(#{row.hitListId}, #{row.hitId}, #{row.listType}, #{row.createTime})
